mapper.sql: id, device_type, device_name, plc_group, tt_index, transfer_no, created_time,remark_id,device_area
mapper.select:
SELECT r.device_type AS deviceType, r.device_name AS deviceName, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, COALESCE(AVG(t.cycle_sec), 0) AS avgCycleSec, 0 AS p95CycleSec FROM tt_record r JOIN ( SELECT i.record_id, SUM(i.time_sec) AS cycle_sec FROM tt_record_item i GROUP BY i.record_id ) t ON t.record_id = r.id
GROUP BY r.device_type, r.device_name ORDER BY r.device_type, r.device_name

SELECT r.id AS id, r.created_time AS createdTime, r.tt_index AS ttIndex, r.plc_group AS plcGroup, r.transfer_no AS transferNo, SUM(i.time_sec) AS cycleSec, i.remark_id AS remarkId, r.device_area AS deviceArea FROM tt_record r LEFT JOIN tt_record_item i ON i.record_id = r.id
GROUP BY r.id, r.created_time, r.tt_index, r.plc_group, r.transfer_no, i.remark_id, r.device_area ORDER BY r.created_time DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(t.cycle_sec, 0) AS cycleSec FROM tt_record r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.record_id, SUM(i.time_sec) AS cycle_sec FROM tt_record_item i GROUP BY i.record_id ) t ON t.record_id = r.id

SELECT r.id AS id, r.created_time AS createdTime, 0 AS ttIndex, r.device_Name AS plcGroup, 0 AS transferNo, SUM(i.time_sec) AS cycleSec, i.remark_id AS remarkId, r.device_area AS deviceArea FROM tt_record r LEFT JOIN tt_record_item i ON i.record_id = r.id
GROUP BY r.id, r.created_time, r.tt_index, r.plc_group, r.transfer_no, i.remark_id, r.device_area ORDER BY r.created_time DESC, r.id DESC

select Z.id,z.createdTime,z.plcGroup,z.cycleSec,z.remarkId,z.deviceArea,x.`step_name`,x.`time_sec` from ( SELECT r.id AS id, r.created_time AS createdTime, 0 AS ttIndex, r.device_Name AS plcGroup, 0 AS transferNo, SUM(i.time_sec) AS cycleSec, i.remark_id AS remarkId, r.device_area AS deviceArea FROM tt_record r LEFT JOIN tt_record_item i ON i.record_id = r.id WHERE r.created_time >= #{f.from} AND r.created_time < #{f.to} AND time_sec > 0 GROUP BY r.id, r.created_time, r.tt_index, r.plc_group, r.transfer_no, i.remark_id, r.device_area ) z LEFT JOIN tt_record_item x ON x.record_id = z.id where x.time_sec > 0 ORDER BY z.createdTime DESC, z.id DESC
